facts.rationale: Corrects table extent and makes conditional countdown semantics explicit without treating rendered names as evidence or assuming a fixed wall-clock duration.
facts.value: Setup clears the first 26 entries of a declared 52-pointer display table, generates 26 availability-dependent ordering keys, initializes the shared completion counter to 180, and starts fog, light, camera and background animations at frame 0. Fog and camera callbacks recount truthy trophy-record results over all 26 character mappings, independently of the surrounding-list exclusions. Fog advances below frame 185 when the first count is at most 5; otherwise it recounts and advances below 200 when that count is at most 13, or without a custom frame cutoff above 13. Camera uses corresponding limits 160, 190 and its own end_frame. Each camera invocation whose selected frame guard fails pre-decrements the shared counter and requests scene exit only when the result equals zero. The guards do not clamp frames, and no local completion latch or countdown saturation is present.
